about: What a data snapshot covers. Read by scripts/release/snapshot/build-sql.mjs. Every table is named with its schema and, to be fingerprinted, with the key that identifies a row. A column is left out of a fingerprint only with a reason. A table of the schemas below that is neither listed nor ignored shows up as a warning in every snapshot.
